purpose: Orchestrate a traceable 1->3->9->36->9->3->1 experimental transformation without embedding the scientific engines in the control plane.

PRIMARY.responsibility: Apply Z fanout 1->3->9, then one pinned major formula F_i per channel.

MIRROR.responsibility: Apply a mirror Z decomposition 1->4 independently to each PRIMARY result.

COUNTERTEST.responsibility: Run identity routing and declared cross-routing matrices P_i as controlled countertests.

PRECISION.responsibility: Apply pinned secondary checks G_ij, then recombine each group 4->1 and measure local return error or declared invariant.

ARBITER.responsibility: Verify nine local checkpoints, trace provenance, then authorize recombination 9->3->1. ARBITER does not recalculate the scientific result.

formula_contract.normalization_rule: Typed normalization must be explicitly declared and tested before 9->3->1 numerical recombination.

checkpoint_contract.compare_recombined_value_to: corresponding F_i output or explicitly declared invariant
